create_env_humanoid_tracking: create an Env instance for humanoid motion tracking simulation with PyBullet physics
run_step_simulation: run one step-forward simulation by advancing physics and actuating agents with target poses
reset_simulation_state: reset the simulation environment to initial state or custom poses and velocities
check_falldown_agent: check if a simulated agent's non-allowed body parts have hit the ground
add_noise_to_pose_vel: add random noise to a simulated agent's joint poses and velocities for training robustness
